draft.title: Genghis Khan
card: Temujin was born around 1162 on the steppe of Central Asia. The Mongols were split into many tribes that often fought each other.
Temujin built alliances and defeated rival leaders. Over many years he brought the Mongol tribes together under one rule.
In 1206 a great gathering of Mongol leaders named him Genghis Khan. The title means ruler of all the Mongols.
Once the tribes were united, Genghis Khan led them in conquests across Asia. His armies attacked kingdoms and cities far beyond the steppe.
draft.remember: Temujin united the tribes first. As Genghis Khan he then led conquests.

a.q: What did Temujin do before he was named Genghis Khan in 1206?
opts: United the Mongol tribes under one rule
Conquered the kingdoms of Europe
Moved the Mongols into walled cities
Founded a dynasty that ruled China
a.why: Temujin first brought the Mongol tribes together, and the gathering of 1206 named him Genghis Khan as their ruler. The conquests across Asia came after this, so conquering kingdoms was not what made him khan.
a.clue: Think about who he ruled before he led armies abroad.

b.q: Why was it important for Genghis Khan's conquests that the Mongol tribes were united first?
opts: The tribes could then fight together as one force
The tribes no longer needed to keep herds
The tribes had stopped using horses for travel
The tribes had already conquered Asia by 1206
b.why: Before 1206 the tribes often fought each other. United under one ruler, they could attack kingdoms and cities beyond the steppe together. The conquests came after 1206, not before it.
b.clue: Before unity, the tribes often fought each other.

a.best: United the Mongol tribes under one rule

b.best: The tribes could then fight together as one force

problems.detail: 'The title means ruler of all the Mongols' is not an accepted meaning of 'Genghis (Chinggis) Khan'. The meaning is debated, and common renderings are 'universal ruler', 'oceanic ruler' or 'firm/fierce ruler'. The card should give one of these, hedged (for example 'is often said to mean universal ruler'), or drop the claim.
